verdict.rationale: Slack supports building bot/app integrations (Events API, Web API, Bolt SDK, app directory) that can be added to channels and respond to @mentions via the Events API's app_mention event, and Slackbot itself is described as a personal AI agent; but the evidence pack never documents a native, no-code way for an 'ai-native user' to simply add a third-party AI agent as a channel member and have it participate on mention without custom app development. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a first-class 'AI agent as channel member' feature (vs. developer-built bot apps), evidence of end-user (non-developer) workflow to add an agent to a channel, and independent/hands-on confirmation that mention-triggered agent participation works as described.
